decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's core postpress automation know-how and fits its modular, inline workflow direction, and it has kept its own page for two years, so the firm can assimilate and extend it within existing systems.

The folding add-on unit is a modular extension of the firm's established Multigraf creasing and cutting line, and a documented customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass gives interpretable, positive evidence on which the firm can build with its application know-how.
